newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Morocco's BP bank group profit up to $61 mln/1996.
newsitem.headline: Morocco's BP bank group profit up to $61 mln/1996.

text.p: Morocco's state-run Banque Populaire group said on Thursday it posted a consolidated net profit of 580 million dirhams ($61 million) in 1996 from 409 million dirhams in 1995 .
In an advertisement published in newspapers, it said net banking income totalled 2.654 billion dirhams ($279 million) in 1996, up 9.6 percent from 2.424 billion dirhams in 1995.
The group's global resources rose 3.4 percent to 46.03 billion dirhams in 1996 compared with the previous year.
Among the country's 18 active banks, BP group holds 32 percent of Morocco's banking market share.
The group, which has 301 branches and employs 6,000 people is slated for privatisation by end 1997 or early 1998, officials said.
The group is not listed on the Casablanca bourse but has three mutual funds operating on the market.
